title: Bessent unveils sweeping new Iran sanctions but delays toughest blow
summary_full: The treasury secretary said Trump is contacting other world leaders to demand their support for the “economic asphyxiation” of the Iranian regime but he declined to say which countries and gave no deadline for action.
